purpose: Scientifically meaningful candidate architecture CLASSES (not a final architecture, not a winner). Each class is composable from the evidence in results/stage4_science_consumption_manifest.json and results/stage4_scientific_sensor_value_matrix.json.
explicit_non_goal: No class is marked as selected, recommended, or winning. final_architecture_status remains UNRESOLVED.

classes.description: Only the sensors with TIER_A_REPLICATED_SUPPORT evidence.
sensors: chest ECG (as reference/ground-truth signal, not itself under incremental-value test)
anatomical_regions: chest (if ECG retained as a monitoring signal, not just reference)
head (frontal, if EEG retained as a monitoring signal)
scientific_capabilities: HR estimation with capacity-controlled, externally-replicated IMU benefit
classes.evidence_confidence: TIER_A for the PPG+IMU pairing; EEG/ECG themselves are foundation signals not under incremental-value test in this evidence set
classes.unresolved_dependencies: None for the included sensors themselves.
classes.pending_science_exposure: NONE - this class does not depend on any HIGH-decision-sensitivity pending result.

classes.description: Minimal Core plus modalities with bounded-but-controlled same-dataset support, assuming low marginal burden via shared infrastructure.
scientific_capabilities: same-dataset sleep-stage classification improvement from EOG
classes.evidence_confidence: TIER_B_CONTROLLED_SUPPORT for EOG (same-dataset); TIER_C_BOUNDED_SUPPORT for EOG's external validity
classes.unresolved_dependencies: EOG's external validity (HMC full-cohort training pending) and whether shared-AFE co-location is engineering-confirmed (Integration Owner's determination, not yet made).
classes.pending_science_exposure: HIGH - EOG's standing in this class is directly sensitive to HMC full-cohort results (see results/stage4_sensor_decision_sensitivity.json scenarios HMC-1/2/3).

classes.description: Core+Context plus modalities with real but not fully replicated, or genuinely mixed/heterogeneous, evidence - included on the basis that the tested endpoint is mission-relevant even though the evidence itself does not yet clearly support inclusion.
scientific_capabilities: central hypovolemic stress / body-mass-change proxy signal acquisition (capability exists; demonstrated incremental value does not)
classes.evidence_confidence: TIER_D_MIXED_OR_FRAGILE for both thoracic EIS and leg BioZ
classes.unresolved_dependencies: Neither modality has demonstrated stable incremental value in current governing evidence; inclusion in this class is a scope/mission-relevance argument, not an evidence-strength argument.
classes.pending_science_exposure: LOW for both - no currently-planned Stage-3 experiment would resolve either modality's ambiguity further (per results/stage4_sensor_decision_sensitivity.json).

classes.description: Evidence-Extended plus modalities with negative-leaning, unresolved, or entirely untested status - included only for explicit experimental/exploratory purposes, never presented as evidence-supported.
scientific_capabilities: PTT-based estimation (capability exists; demonstrated value is currently NEGATIVE)
classes.evidence_confidence: TIER_E_NEGATIVE_OR_DEPRIORITIZED for second-site PPG; TIER_P_PENDING for wrist temperature/light
classes.unresolved_dependencies: Second-site PPG has a demonstrated negative result, not merely an absence of evidence - its inclusion here is explicitly experimental/exploratory, not evidence-driven.
classes.pending_science_exposure: LOW for second-site PPG (no planned experiment); MEDIUM for wrist temperature/light (any new experiment would be informative given the complete absence of current evidence).

note_on_composability: Each class is defined as a strict superset of the prior class for clarity of presentation; this is a simplification for readability, not a claim that a real architecture decision must proceed monotonically through these tiers - the Coordinator may select any subset consistent with the acceptance gates in results/stage4_architecture_acceptance_gates.json.
